name: Bard College Berlin
summary: Small English-taught liberal arts college in Berlin: about 300 students from 71 countries, classes of about 10, and a German plus a US BA.

ib.text: The German BA needs an IB that meets Germany's KMK rule (six set subject groups, a 4 in each); BCB publishes it as an IB sheet. English at C1, waived after a year of English-taught school.

apply.via: Common App or BCB's own online form

programmes.name: BA in Economics, Politics, and Social Thought
programmes.about: A major in economics or politics, taught in small seminars inside a shared core on the great texts and debates of intellectual history, with German along the way and a BA thesis in year four.
programmes.ib: No German needed to apply; you must show intermediate German by the end of year two.
programmes.selectionNote: Your file (motivation statement, graded school essay, transcripts, two references) is read first; shortlisted applicants get a 30-minute online interview. No cut-off published.

programmes.name: BA in Humanities, the Arts, and Social Thought
programmes.about: Philosophy, literature, art and political thought read closely in small seminars, with a major in art and aesthetics, ethics and politics, or literature and rhetoric, and a BA thesis in year four.
programmes.ib: No German needed to apply; you must show intermediate German by the end of year two.
programmes.selectionNote: Your file (motivation statement, graded school essay, transcripts, two references) is read first; shortlisted applicants get a 30-minute online interview. No cut-off published.

programmes.name: BA in Artistic Practice and Society
programmes.about: Make art and think about it: studio work in painting, sculpture, film, writing, performance, sound and more alongside the shared core, ending in a capstone that pairs a creative work with an academic thesis.
programmes.ib: Up to 10 samples of your artistic work, uploaded with the application. No German needed to apply; you must show intermediate German by the end of year two.
programmes.selectionNote: Art samples plus the usual file (motivation statement, graded essay, transcripts, two references); those going forward get a 30-minute online interview. No places published.

notes: There is no application fee; you send a motivation statement, a graded essay written for a class and two teacher recommendations, and shortlisted applicants get a 30-minute online interview.
If your IB does not meet Germany's recognition rule you can still earn the US BA, which BCB grants on the basis of your national school diploma.
The 2026/27 comprehensive fee is €38,250 on campus or €27,500 off campus, and BCB says 85% of students receive financial aid.
